plugins.name: raizen-hub
plugins.description: Settle an internal app one layer at a time, whether the layer is empty or already running: app-settle for the domain, stack and PRD.md; logic-settle for the layer between database and UI; design-settle for the visual direction and PRD Section 5; app-conform to bring code that predates these rules back onto them.

plugins.name: raizen-norms
plugins.description: Session norms for internal app repos: git and destructive-operation guards, plus PRD, UI, database, application-logic, and build-order rules.
